strings.map4_s04.lisa_do_you_know_a:

strings.map4_s04.weird_occult_stuff_black_magic:

strings.map4_s04.as_young_people_moved_away:
{wait1 5.0}Молодёжь разъезжалась,

strings.map4_s04.evidently_things_like_that:

strings.map4_s04.before_the_resort_there_really:

strings.map4_s04.everyone_was_so_flipped_out:

strings.map4_s04.then_a_lot_of_new:
{wait1 3.8}Потом понаехало много

strings.map4_s04.last_time_i_heard_anything:
{wait 4.8}Последний раз я слышала

strings.map4_s04.when_several_people_connected:
{wait1 4.4}Когда несколько человек,

strings.map4_s04.thank_god_you_came_back:
{wait 4.6}Слава богу, ты вернулся.

strings.map4_s04.theres_a_water_works_over:

strings.map4_s04.theres_an_underground_tunnel:

strings.map4_s04.you_think_i_can_get:

strings.map4_s04.ive_never_been_down_in:

strings.map4_s04.besides_its_all_fenced_off:

strings.map4_s04.this_may_not_be_the:

strings.map4_s04.i_cant_promise_you_anything:

strings.map4_s04.no_somehow_i_feel_im:

strings.map4_s04.oh_harry_im_so_scared:
{wait1 4.0}Ах, Гарри, мне так страшно...
